espn-604009.headline: France beat South Africa; now they need four tries
beats: Eight days after beating South Africa 21–19 at the Stade de France, France meet Argentina on the same ground needing a bonus-point win. Get it and they go above England, top the North and reach the grand final.
Four tries has not been the hard part. France scored six against Australia, six against Japan and eight against Fiji. The Springboks allowed them three.
Argentina lost 42–12 to Ireland, then won 19–14 in Italy without looking much better for it. They are also without Juan Cruz Mallía, their best player.
Antoine Dupont says he cannot remember an easy game against Argentina. France need this one to be easy enough to score four.

espn-604010.headline: Wales beat New Zealand, then changed four players
beats: Last Saturday's 35–28 was Wales's first win over New Zealand in 73 years, saved by a defensive stand over the final 20 minutes in Cardiff. Steve Tandy's men now have to find that level again a week later, against a side with something to prove.
Australia have lost four straight. New Zealand put 50 and 43 on them in October, then 28 on Wales. England scored 45 against them, and Scotland edged them 12–15 on 15 November.
Win by 16 or more and Wales go above Australia into eighth in the world, a margin a side who conceded 43 to South Africa in July cannot take for granted.

Liam Wright will be watching. His last Test was in July 2024, captaining Australia against Wales, and he is Welsh-qualified next summer. "I imagine myself playing Test rugby and wanting to do it in a gold jersey, but I'm not going to turn down opportunities anywhere."
